gaps.sentence: Hurry ___ or we'll miss the ferry!
The plane will drop ___ the parcels at the next farm.
gaps.explanation: drop off = deliver somebody/something; also become less (sales dropped off).

gaps.sentence: Her essay stands ___ from the rest of the class.
gaps.explanation: stand out = be easy to notice, be better/different.

gaps.sentence: Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.

gaps.sentence: She's taken ___ knitting to relax after work.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby, sport, activity).

gaps.sentence: Please hand ___ your essays by Friday.
gaps.hint: give to a person in authority
gaps.explanation: hand in = give work/documents to somebody in authority.

gaps.sentence: Put ___ your coat — it's freezing outside.
gaps.explanation: put on = dress in; put off = postpone.
